in_hebrew.name: Eudo
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rich in wealth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eudo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘eudos’, meaning ‘good, prosperous, or fortunate’. This name was given to children born into wealthy families or those who were believed to bring good fortune.

in_greek.name: Eudo
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Rich in wealth
in_greek.long_meaning: Eudo είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word ‘eudos’, meaning ‘good, prosperous, or fortunate’. This name was given to children born into wealthy families or those who were believed to bring good fortune.

in_latin.name: Eudo
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Rich in wealth
in_latin.long_meaning: Eudo est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word ‘eudos’, meaning ‘good, prosperous, or fortunate’. This name was given to children born into wealthy families or those who were believed to bring good fortune.
